limitations: A canonical PRE re-verification and content/file-identity recheck are not an atomic write operation.
A concurrent malicious mutation or rename between the last check and Path.write_bytes is not excluded by these proofs.
Windows kernel stable-handle/no-reparse/exclusive-write proof is not implemented.
Power loss and OS hard crash durability not experimentally validated.
No automatic review of semantic relevance of every modified/untracked file; all changed files are hashed and listed.
